messages.author: dae01c57a3c54a3a
messages.subject: Odd install issue
parts:
A student in one of my classes had rstan running fine until she updated her OS X, then it stopped working. I helped her re-install the command-line tools (via `xcode-select --install` in terminal) and complete the configuration & install as described on the wiki. When we run:

fx <- inline::cxxfunction( signature(x = "integer", y = "numeric" ) , '
    return ScalarReal( INTEGER(x)[0] * REAL(y)[0] ) ;
' )
fx( 2L, 5 ) # should be 10

she indeed gets `10` as the output. However, when we run:

library(stan)
stan_model(model_code = 'parameters {
  real y;
}
model {
  y ~ normal(0, 1);
}
')

she gets the error:

Error in if (nchar(CXX) == 0) { : argument is of length zero
  In addition: Warning message:
    running command ''/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Resources/bin/R' CMD config CXX 2>/dev/null' had status 2

Any idea what's going on or how to troubleshoot this?
